name: alwrity_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the alwrity capability.

prompts.name: content_strategy
prompts.template: Create a content strategy plan targeting {target_audience} with a focus on {primary_goals} using keywords {keywords_list}.
prompts.use_case: Automated digital marketing strategy development for businesses and agencies.

prompts.name: generate_multimodal_content
prompts.template: Generate a {content_type} about {topic} with a {style} style and length of {length}.
prompts.use_case: Creating diverse marketing materials such as blog posts, social media posts, videos, and images using AI.

prompts.name: publish_content
prompts.template: Publish the content titled '{content_title}' to {social_platforms} on {scheduled_date}.
prompts.use_case: Scheduling and managing publishing across multiple social media platforms.

prompts.name: request_analytics_report
prompts.template: Provide analytics report for campaigns between {start_date} and {end_date} focusing on {metrics}.
prompts.use_case: Tracking campaign performance and generating actionable marketing analytics reports.

prompts.name: seo_optimization
prompts.template: Suggest SEO improvements for the content about {topic} focusing on keywords {keywords_list}.
prompts.use_case: Implementing AI-powered SEO improvements to enhance online content visibility.

prompts.name: connect_social_account
prompts.template: Connect and authenticate social media account for platform {platform_name} with credentials {credentials}.
prompts.use_case: Centralized management of multiple social media accounts and campaigns.
